name: Start
description: the entry: a start-up check, DS = 193c, SS:SP = 7d78:03e8, mode 13h, then the loop of 1000:0100 and 1000:0220; on the way out the video mode back and int 21h 4c00

name: Main_Restart
description: longjmp-style abort to the menus: DS = ES = 193c, SS:SP reloaded from [0004]/[0006] (saved by Start at 0054), 00e2, then jumps into Start at 0054 (re-saves the stack, re-enters the attract loop); reached by tail jumps from 115c and 216c (leaving a game)

name: Snd_StopAll
description: unless [0f64] = 1 (no sound driver, inferred), calls the driver with AH=10h AL=0; all registers but AX kept

name: Menu_Attract
description: the attract screens (the first half of Start's loop): DS = ES = 193c, 7af8, driver AH=7, 8, 6, tune 1 (AH=9 AL=1, then AH=4 if it answers nonzero), the four players' input bytes [137b] [14df] [1643] [17a7] and [1080] [107e] [107f] [1082] cleared; clears the back buffer, LOGO.CHR (object 0b97) and the copyright line centred at row b7h (font 0b54); then cycles [0bc5] through the nine vehicle classes, each shown for 118h ticks of [0002] (01de, 08bc, 32ce), polling 2d5b; returns CF=0 on player 1's fire ([137b] bit 3) or any other key released ([107e] not 0/1), CF=1 on Esc released ([107e] = 1)

name: Menu_DrawAttractVehicle
description: draws INTRO.CHR (object 0bb2, frame [bc5], x [bb4] = 50h, y [bb6]) opaquely, clears 8 rows at [bb6]+40h and writes the class name number [bc5] from the list at 002f centred there (font 0b40); registers kept

name: Menu_SelectPlayers
description: the second half of Start's loop: tune 1, clears [0156] and [1096], draws the SELECT GAME / ONE PLAYER / TWO PLAYER screen (LOGO.CHR, SELGAM.CHR object 0c8a and WORDS.CHR object 0ca5 frames), then 0382 at row 80h with the choice remembered in [0130]: 0 (timeout or Esc) -> CF=1; 1 -> 02e0 (one-player game types); 2 -> 1e20 (two-player game); CF=0 after a game

name: Menu_OnePlayerGame
description: the one-player game screen: 0400 backdrop, headings, two game types as SELGAM/WORDS frames, 0382 at row 6eh with the choice in [0132] and [0156] (the backdrop's sub-heading frame); 0eba resets the drivers' carousel, 0400; choice 1 -> 0fbf (head to head against one computer driver, [2656] = 2), 2 -> 102b (the challenge, [2656] = 1); 0 (Esc, timeout) returns, leaving [0132] = 0

name: Menu_ChooseOfTwo
description: a two-way choice with THUMB.CHR (object 0c6f) as the pointer: BX = the pointer's row (into [0c73]), AX = the initial choice 1/2 (the pointer frame [0c82]); clears [1080] (menus read players 1 and 2 together) and [107e]; waits for fire to be released, then polls 2d5b each tick of [0002]: left ([108b] bit 7) = 1, right (bit 6) = 2, fire (bit 3) returns CX = the choice; CX = 0 on Esc ([107e] = 1) or after 7d0h ticks without a choice; redraws with 04b8/05b4 and shows the pointer's 38h rows (089c); the wait for fire's release leaves only bit 3 in [108b] (and byte [108b], 8)

name: Menu_DrawBackdrop
description: the menus' common backdrop: back buffer cleared (0876 colour 0), BADGE.CHR (object 0b7c), the WORDS.CHR title (object 0ca5 at 48h,8 frame 0) and, if [0156] is not 0, the sub-heading frame [0156] to its right with a three-row underline (colours 12h, 0eh, 12h at rows 1eh-21h)

name: Gfx_InitObject
description: fills a sprite object (BX) from its image record ([BX] -> record: width +0dh, height +0fh, segment +12h): [BX+8] segment, [BX+0f] width, [BX+11] height, [BX+0b] = width*height (the frame size); registers kept

name: Gfx_DrawObjectSaved
description: clips the object (0630; carry = off screen: returns), saves the background under it (05f3) and falls into the transparent draw (04bd); BX = object

name: Gfx_DrawObjectMasked
description: second entry of 04b8 (clip already done): copies the clipped frame (image segment [BX+8], offset [BX+0d], row skip [BX+17], rows [BX+19], columns [BX+1a]) into the back buffer 6d78 at [BX+15], colour 0 transparent, mirrored left-right if [BX+0a] = 1; registers kept

name: Gfx_DrawObject
description: clips the object (0630; carry = off screen) and copies its frame opaquely into the back buffer 6d78 (words then a byte per row; mirrored byte by byte if [BX+0a] = 1); BX = object, registers kept

name: Gfx_RestoreUnder
description: if the object was drawn ([BX+15] != -1), copies the saved background back from segment [BX+6] into the back buffer at [BX+15] and marks it undrawn ([BX+15] = -1)

name: Gfx_SaveUnder
description: if the object is on screen and has a save segment ([BX+6] != 0), copies the back-buffer rectangle at [BX+15] (rows [BX+19], columns [BX+1a]) to [BX+6]:0000

name: Gfx_ClipObject
description: clips an object (BX: x [BX+2], y [BX+4], frame [BX+13], frame size [BX+0b], width [BX+0f], height [BX+11]) to the 256 x 200 window: sets the source offset [BX+0d], destination [BX+15] (back buffer, row stride 110h, origin 888h), row skip [BX+17], rows [BX+19], columns [BX+1a]; CF=1 and [BX+15] = -1 when nothing is visible

name: Gfx_FrameObject
description: draws a one-pixel rectangle of colour AL around the object's clipped area (one pixel outside it) in the back buffer; registers kept

name: Gfx_DrawTileMap
description: draws a map of 8 x 8 tiles into the back buffer at DI (+888h): SI = the map's image record (segment +12h holds columns, rows, then one tile number per byte), BX = the tile set's record (segment +12h, 64 bytes per tile); registers kept

name: Pal_LoadFile
description: opens the file named at DS:DX, reads 300h bytes into 6d78:0000, sets all 256 DAC registers from it (int 10h 1012h) and clears the text window (int 10h 06h); registers kept

name: Gfx_RecolourRect
description: in the back buffer rectangle at x AX, y BX, SI wide, CX high, replaces every pixel of colour DH by DL

name: Gfx_FillRect
description: fills the back buffer rectangle at x AX, y BX, DX wide, CX high with colour SI (low byte); registers kept

name: Gfx_FillRows
description: fills CL full rows (256 pixels) of the back buffer from row BX with colour AL (rep stosd: needs a 386); joins 0876's loop

name: Gfx_ClearBuffer
description: fills all 200 rows of the back buffer 6d78 with colour AL; second entry 0862 shares its loop

name: Gfx_PresentRows
description: copies CX rows from row AX of the back buffer (stride 110h) to the VGA screen A000 (stride 140h, x from 32: the 256-pixel window centred) with rep movsd; joins 08bc's loop

name: Gfx_Present
description: copies the whole 256 x 200 window of the back buffer 6d78 to A000 at x 32; registers kept

name: Text_DrawNth
description: skips CX zero-terminated strings from SI and draws the next one: centred (0910) if AX = -1, else at x AX (0929); BX = row, DX = font record; registers kept

name: Text_DrawCentred
description: draws the string at SI centred in the 256-pixel window (x = 127 - 4 * length): BX = row, DX = font record

name: Text_Draw
description: draws the zero-terminated string at SI in the back buffer: AX = x (negative: clipped on the left, whole characters skipped), BX = y, DX = font record (height +0dh, glyph segment +12h); 8-pixel cells, spaces skipped, stops at x 107h; registers kept

name: Text_DrawGlyph
description: draws one 8-pixel-wide glyph (AL = character: 0-9, A-Z, ! and ? map to glyphs 0-37) of AH rows from segment DX at ES:DI, colour 0 transparent

name: Menu_SelectCharacter
description: the "who do you want to be / race" carousel of the eleven drivers: AX = start slot (-1 keeps [0192]), SI = the prompt (into [019a], font 0b40 at row 62h), [019e] = the player's face object (0c03, 0c1e, 0c39, 0c54); tune 2 (AH=9/4 AL=2); a previous pick goes back to the pool ([0164] list); left/right turn the carousel (0cd3), fire picks the face in front ([0160]) unless taken (bit 6 set in [0164+n]), flashes it, stores it in [2668]/[266a]/[266c]/[266e] for objects 0c03/0c1e/0c39/0c54 (players 1 and 2 also get 0b51's handicap bit); returns AX = [0160], CF=0; CF=1 on Esc

name: Menu_AskHandicap
description: for drivers 0-2 (Walter, Mike, Anne; AX = driver) unless [2656] = 1 or [265a] = 6: asks HANDICAP name ? with NO/YES (left/right, fire or button 2 to confirm), remembering the answer per driver in [01d6+n]; returns AX = 0 or 80h (the handicap flag); else AX = 0

name: Menu_PressAnyKey
description: the press-a-key prompt (string 0241 at row 62h, blinking through 0c96) until fire, any key released ([107e]) or 2bch ticks of [261f]

name: Menu_ShowClassName
description: writes the vehicle class [09d8] (1-based) centred at row bfh from list 002f or, if [26cf] bit 0 is set, list 00ab, and shows those 8 rows; registers kept

name: Menu_BlinkMessage
description: redraws the menu message line: string [019a] (none if 0), font [0194] (8 rows for 0b40, else 16) at row [0196]; the text is drawn only while [26cf] bit 0 is set (toggled by the timer handler), so it blinks; shows the rows

name: Menu_TurnCarousel
description: turns the drivers' carousel by one slot (64 units of [0192], modulo 2c0h) in the direction of BX's sign, in 13 eased steps (table at 0185), one tick of [261f] each, redrawing (0d1f) and showing rows 76h-c6h

name: Menu_DrawCarousel
description: draws the carousel: background bands (colours 0eh, 12h, 0) at rows 77h-b7h, then the eleven faces of the pool [0164] with FCNORMAL.CHR (object 0be8) at x = slot position - d8h for slot positions [0192] + 40h * n, the one at 140h becoming the selection [0160], each with its name (0258) and rating (02b1) through 0f17; then the frame (0e02); registers kept

name: Menu_DrawFace
description: draws a face object (BX): [BX+13] low byte = driver, high byte = expression (0 FCNORMAL, 1 FCFROWN, 2 FCHAPPY, 3 FCSAD; with expression 0, bit 5 or 6 of the driver byte shows frame 0ch or 0dh: the taken markers); temporarily points [BX] and [BX+8] at the expression's image, draws (053a) and restores [BX+13]

name: Menu_DrawCarouselFrame
description: draws FRAME.CHR (object 0d47) pieces, plain and mirrored ([BX+0a]), around the carousel window (x 5ch-9ch, y 6eh-b6h) and two colour-12h lines at rows 76h and b7h

name: Menu_ResetCharacters
description: resets the drivers' selection: [0160] = 6, [0192] = 0, [0406]-[0409] = 3, the pool [0164] = 0..10, the picks [2668] [266a] [266c] [266e] and the face objects' frames [0c16] [0c31] [0c4c] [0c67] = 0bh (none); registers kept

name: Menu_DrawFaceLabel
description: unless the object BX is off screen, writes the 8-character entry number ([BX+13] and 0fh) of the table at AX (0258 names, 02b1 ratings) at x [0bea], row CX (font 0b40)

name: Menu_DrawFaceName
description: writes the driver's name (table 0258, entry [BX+13] and 0fh) 31h rows below the face object BX, or fills that 48-pixel strip if no driver (>= 0bh), with the colour the caller left in SI's low byte; registers kept

name: Dead_SaveLevelFile
description: unreferenced: creates GAME1.LVL (name at 0889) and writes DS 040a-081d and 1feb-23b6 into it, then closes it: the counterpart of 0f99 (a saved game or a tool for building the file)

name: File_LoadGameSet
description: opens the file named at DS:SI (a GAMEn.LVL: called from 2be8 with 193c:0889 "GAME1.LVL" and with the names found by its directory scan) and reads its two parts into the data segment: 414h bytes at 193c:040a (to 081e: the championship's race list [0439..], track names [0460..], etc.) and 3cch bytes at 193c:1feb (to 23b7); no error check; closes it

name: Menu_HeadToHeadGame
description: one-player "head to head" game (choice 1 of the one-player game screen, from 02e0): [03f8] = 1 (head-to-head flag), [2656] = 2 (two racers), [03f3] = [0310] = 0, [1080] = 137b (player 1's input result), [265a] = 6, cs:[9c62] (= 193c:08a2) = 0, input slots rebuilt (2d00); the player picks a character (the pick-yourself prompt, object 0c03, 09e0) and then an opponent (the pick-an-opponent prompt, object 0c1e), each kept in [03f4]/[03f6]; then 0c15 and the race series 10a0; Esc at either pick (carry from 09e0) skips; [265a] back from [0f61], slots rebuilt

name: Menu_ChampionshipGame
description: one-player championship (choice 2 of the one-player game screen): [03f8] = [03f3] = [0342] = [0310] = 0, [2656] = 1 (four racers), [1080] = 137b, [265a] = 6, cs:[9c62] = 0, slots rebuilt (2d00); character object 0c03 placed at 68h,27h with a box (06cc colour 0dh); the pick-yourself prompt (09e0, previous pick [03f4]); on a pick: [03f4] = the character, 0c15, [266a] = 6, the series 10a0; [265a] restored from [0f61]

name: Race_Series
description: the one-player series of races (championship or head to head): [03fa] = 3 (wins before a bonus race), [0343] = [28c1] (race number) = [0310] = 0, [266c] = [266e] = 6; runs the qualifying race (115c); if the player (object 0c03) was not first ([03fc]) and, outside head to head, not second ([03fe]): failed-to-qualify (1c1b cx=0) and back; else QUALIFIED (1c1b cx=1) and, in the championship, the opponents are picked again (1a4a); then each race of the list (up to [0439]) is run (115c) and its results shown (13e4, carry = no lives left: back); in head to head a lost race is repeated; in the championship three wins ([03fa] counts down) give a bonus race (1a82); after the last race the winner's screen (1aad, bx = 0c03)

name: Race_RunOne
description: sets up and runs one race of the series: the theme [28bf] and track [28c0] (1-based) from the race list byte [043c + [28c1]] (theme * 4 + track - 1), or theme 9 and track [0342] + 1 for a bonus race ([0343] = 1); the progress map (18d8) unless head to head or the last race; the pre-race screen (11f8); [0311] = 0, [1082] = 1 (in race), the driver's music stopped (AH = 7), the race itself (3039, DS saved), [0406] (lives) = 10 when cheat flag [0f69] = 1, [1082] = 0; the finishing order converted (11d5), the front end reloaded (26c0); if the race was quit ([1096] = 1) a tail jump to 1000:00cc (the stack reset to the front end)

name: Race_ResultsToRacers
description: converts the race's finishing order [2678..267e] (vehicle record offsets, multiples of [2662] = 164h) into the front end's racer objects (0c03 + 1bh * n) at [03fc] (first) .. [0402] (fourth); registers kept

name: Menu_PreRaceScreen
description: the screen before a race: music 4 (5 for race 1ah) through the driver (AH = 9 asks, AH = 4 plays); for theme 9 (bonus): TRIPLE WIN !!!, BONUS RACE, beat-the-clock, the class picture (01de, [0bc5] = 8) and TIMETRIALS; for race 0 (outside head to head): QUALIFYING / RACE and the class picture; else the racers' portraits (19f2), the track name (1867), the class picture, and the four racers' small pictures (objects 0cdb..0d2c) sliding in two pixels a frame (two in head to head); then a key wait (179b); with the cheat flag [0f6a] set, keypad + / - (scan codes 4eh / 4ah released, [107e]) step [28c1] up or down (wrapping at 0 to [0439]), recompute [28bf]/[28c0] and redo the screen

name: Menu_RaceResults
description: after a race of the one-player series; carry = game over. Head to head: a lost race costs a life (1c1b cx=2), carry when [0406] = 0. Championship: music 8 (won) or 6, RESULTS!, the track name, the four racers ([03fc]..[0402]) put in a 2 x 2 grid with boxes and frames, their pictures sliding in, QUALIFY / FAILED under the player; the places marked in the objects' frame words; flashing until a key or 700 ticks ([261f]); not first or second: life-lost (1c1b cx=2), carry when no lives; every third race ([0310] mod 3 = 0) the next opponent in turn ([0346], from 0c1e to 0c54; at race 3 the one with the lowest character number) is knocked out (16de) while characters are left in the roster [0164..016e]

name: Menu_RacerIsOut
description: AX = a racer object (0c1e..0c54): its character's roster byte [0164 + n] gets 20h (out), the object 40h; music 6; the portraits (19f2), the character's name (list at [0258], 8 bytes each) and IS OUT!!; the character hops off the screen (offsets from [034b], 9 ticks a step, frown picture from [0a3a]); then a key wait (179b) and a new opponent picked (1a4a); registers kept

name: Menu_WaitKey
description: waits for the fire bit (8) of [108b] to be released and pressed again, or any key released ([107e] <> 0), or 700 ticks of [0002] (the first part) / of cs:[93c2] (= 193c:0002 read through CS); input read each tick (2d5b) with [1080] = 0 meanwhile (restored after); [0002] reset to 0

name: Menu_WaitKeyBlink
description: CX = ticks: waits up to CX ticks of [0002] (reset) for fire released, then up to CX more for fire pressed; carry set = time ran out (the caller flips its blinking picture and calls again), clear = fire or a key ([107e]); [1080] saved and 0 meanwhile

name: Menu_DrawTrackName
description: BX = row: the name of track [28c0] of theme [28bf] (entry (theme - 1) * 4 + track - 1 of the zero-separated list at [0460], font 0b54) centred, with RACE nn (string [03ae], digits [28c1] by 1a34) to its left; for the last race ([28c1] = [0439]) the name alone, centred (08f0)

name: Menu_ProgressMap
description: between championship races (not race 0, not when [043a] = 0): the map of the races so far (198e), presented; the current race's marker blinks (17ff, 23h ticks) until fire or 700 ticks of [261f]; for theme 9 instead a column of bonus pictures (object 0cdb frames 20h.., x 95h/b5h, rows 8eh..beh) alternates with the map

name: Menu_DrawProgressMap
description: draws the championship map: the tile picture CASE.MAP / CASE.CHR (0710 with descriptors 0ab4, 0aa0, at back-buffer offset 21ffh) and for each race already run (0..[28c1]-1) a small picture (object 0cdb, frame from the race byte [043d + i]: track * 8 + theme - 1) at the grid position [0312 + 2i] (x * 8 + 0ch, y * 8 + 4eh)

name: Menu_DrawRacers
description: clears the screen with the title (0400) and draws the racers' portraits in a row at y = 24h, 40h apart from x = 8: objects 0c03..0c54 (four), or 0c03 and 0c1e from x = 47h in head to head ([03f8]); each with its frame masked to 4fh, a box (06cc colour 0dh) and its name label (0f3c)

name: Text_TwoDigits
description: AL = 0..99: two ASCII digits into [SI], [SI+1]; a leading zero becomes a space; registers kept

name: Menu_PickOpponents
description: the portraits (19f2); for each racer object 0c03..0c54 whose frame is 0bh (an empty place) the player picks a character for it (the pick-an-opponent prompt, 09e0 with [019e] = the object; Esc repeats the pick); [0404] = the last object filled; then 0c15 (the press-a-key prompt)

name: Race_BonusRace
description: a bonus race: [0343] = 1 so that 115c runs theme 9, track [0342] + 1; then NO BONUS (1c1b cx=4), or when the race's bonus flag [291d] = 1 EXTRA LIFE (cx=3) and the next bonus track ([0342] + 1, up to [043b])

name: Menu_ChampionScreen
description: BX = the winning racer object: music 3; CHAMPIONSHIP WINNER!! ([0384]) slides in from the left ([03aa] from -0b0h to 28h) and the winner's name from the right ([03ac] from 100h to 68h), a cup (object 0cc0, frames 1..8 stacked) and the winner (happy picture from [0a26]) bouncing (frame flips every 15 ticks); then waits for any input bit ([108b] <> 0, [1080] = 0); the object's frame word restored

name: Menu_LivesMessage
description: CX = message: 0 failed-to-qualify, 1 qualified-for-challenge (5 qualified-for-head-to-head when [03f8]), 2 life-lost, 3 EXTRA LIFE, 4 NO BONUS (zero-separated list at [081f]); the player's portrait (object 0c03, happy or sad by CX bit 0, box colour 0dh), music 8 (odd) or 6 (even); for 1..3 and 5: LIVES nn ([0893], digits of [0406] at [0899]/[089c]); for 2 and 3 the digit rolls down or up one row at a time while [0406] is decremented or incremented, with five retrace waits (3165) per step and the palette faded in once ([0311], 32ce); then fire, a key or 700 ticks of [261f]; the key with scan code 1bh released sets [0406] = 0 (returns BX = 0)

name: Menu_TwoPlayerGame
description: the two-player game (from 0220): the two small pictures (0cdb, 0cf6) placed, [03f3] = [0156] = [03f8] = 1, [2656] = 2, [09d6] = 0, [265a] = [0f61], slots rebuilt (2d00), game state reset (0eba), the portraits (19f2); PLAYER ONE picks a character (09e0, object 0c03, input [1080] = 137b, previous [09a0]), then PLAYER TWO (object 0c1e, [1080] = 14df, previous [09a2]); then the game menu 1ef1; [03f3] = 0 on the way out

name: Menu_TwoPlayerChoose
description: music 2; the four win tallies [0989..098c] and [08a2] cleared; CHOOSE GAME! with TOURNAMENT and SINGLE RACE under two pictures (object 0c8a frames 4, 5); the choice (0382 on row 90h, previous [08a0]): 0 = back; [08a0] = [08a2] = the choice, [2656] = 2; 1 = the tournament (1faf); 2 = single races (2329, [0194] kept) and then this menu again (tail loop)

name: Menu_TwoPlayerTournament
description: the two-player tournament: [0988] = [08a5] = 1, [28c1] = 1; each race a track drawn at random from the eight entries at [09ba] (theme * 4 + track - 1) without repeats (flags [09c2..09c9], refilled when all used; index = [0002] and 7, retried until free), [28bf]/[28c0]/[09d8] set; the header (240a, 2481), TOURNAMENT RACE nn, the class picture (object 0bb2) and the sliding track pictures (2216), a key wait, the race (216c), the result (256e); until a player's tally ([098a] for 0c03, [098c] for 0c1e) reaches 4: the champion screen (1aad)

name: Dead_TwoPlayerResult
description: not reached (no reference): an older two-player result screen: music 8, the per-character win and loss counts [09a4 + n] / [09af + n] and the tallies [0989..098c] counted for the winner [03fc], the places put in the objects' frames, the counts drawn (22b6), RESULTS!! and TOURNAMENT RACE, the class picture and track pictures (2216), the two racers flashing until fire (17ff 14h ticks); 256e is the version in use

name: Race_RunTwoPlayer
description: runs a two-player race: [1082] = 1, the driver's music stopped (AH = 7), the race (3039, DS saved), [1082] = 0, the front end reloaded (26c0); a quit race ([1096] = 1) tail-jumps to 1000:00cc; else the finishing order converted (11d5)

name: Menu_StepVehicleClass
description: BX = +1 / -1 / 0: music 2; moves [08a3] through 0..9 (wrapping) and takes the pair at [09d9 + 2n]: [09d8] = the vehicle class (1..11, its name from the list at [002f]), [28c0] = the track; the theme [28bf] = the class, except class 10 -> theme 3 and 11 -> theme 1; the class picture (object 0bb2, frame theme - 1, at 7fh,50h) and the class banner (2216); the rows presented; registers kept

name: Menu_ClassBanner
description: clears the rows under objects 0bec and [0bb6], writes the vehicle class name ([09d8] - 1 of the list at [002f], font 0b40, centred), and slides the two track pictures (0cdb frame theme - 1 from the left, 0cf6 frame theme + 7 from the right, [263a] * 4 pixels a frame) until they meet at x = 58h, each step drawn, presented and erased; clears cs:[4ade] and waits for the retrace (3165) per step

name: Dead_TwoPlayerCounts
description: reached only from the dead 2099: for both players ([0c16], [0c31] and 0fh) the character's win and loss counts [09a4 + n] / [09af + n] as WON nn and LOST nn at x = 4 and x = 0beh (rows 32h, 3bh, font 0b40)

name: Menu_TwoPlayerSingleRace
description: two-player single races: [08a5] = [0988] = 0, music 2; the two racers' header (240a at y 24h, 2481) and a vehicle picture (object 0c6f), SELECT VEHICLE; after fire is released, left / right ([108b] bits 40h / 80h) step the vehicle class (2193), the class name redrawn on row bfh each tick (0c5d); fire: the race (216c) and its result (256e), then again; Esc ([107e] = 1) returns

name: Menu_TwoPlayerHeader
description: AX = row: the title (0400) and the two racers' portraits (objects 0c03 at x 20h and 0c1e at x b0h, frames masked to 4fh, boxes 0dh, name labels 0f3c); in a tournament ([08a5]) their tallies [098a] / [098c] drawn as digits (list at [08a6]) beside them

name: Menu_TwoPlayerRatings
description: for both racers: the character's wins [09a4 + n] and losses [09af + n] as WON nn / LOST nn beside the portrait, and a rating word from the list at [08cd] (GRANNY .. EXPERT) indexed by the table byte [08b0 + clamp(losses - wins + 10, 0, 20)]

name: Menu_TwoPlayerResult
description: after a two-player race: the winner ([03fc] = 0c03 or 0c1e) gets a tally ([098a] / [098c]) and its character a win, the other a loss ([09a4 + n] / [09af + n]); [03fc]/[03fe] reordered as winner and loser; music 8; the header (240a at 64h), the ratings (2481), WINNER! / LOSER! under each, the places in the frame words, RESULTS!! and SINGLE RACE or TOURNAMENT RACE, the palette faded in (32ce), the two track pictures sliding in (to x 58h) and the racers flashing until fire or a key (17ff, 14h ticks)

name: Menu_LoadFrontEnd
description: reloads the front end after a race (and at start-up): interrupts off; the pictures from COMPRESS.PI0 ([09f0]) on unpacked into segment 1b78 onwards (3547; inferred), every picture object 0b7c..0d47 (1bh apart) re-initialised from its descriptor (049c), the sound driver reloaded (321c), INTRO.PAL loaded and set (26ec); interrupts on

name: Pal_LoadIntro
description: loads INTRO.PAL ([0d62]) into 6d78:0000 and sets the DAC from it (07a0, which also clears the text screen), then sets all 256 DAC entries again from 6d78:0000 (int 10h 1012h)

name: Dead_LoadExtraChr
description: not reached: reads 1plr_xtr.chr ([09fd]) into the picture segment of object 0c8a, the length computed from its header (width [si+0bh] times 3 plus [si+0dh]); a left-over

name: Dead_DumpMemory
description: not reached: creates Paul.dat ([0a0a]) and writes memory from segment 1b78 up to 6d78 into it in 4 KB blocks: a developer's memory dump

name: Menu_GameOptions
description: the game options screen. Once per run ([0eff]) reads SETTINGS.DAT (name at [0ed0]) into [0da8] and spreads it: [0f5f] player 1 control, [0f61] player 2 control, [263a] smoothness, [0f64] sound (default 2, or 1 if [262d] says a Sound Blaster was found), joystick X thresholds [28fd] [28ff] [2905] [2907], 16 key scan codes to [106c]. Draws the options (text table at [0e17], an extra calibrate line when [2625] joysticks exist), waits for a released key [107e]: F1/F2 cycle the players' control (1 joystick A, 2 joystick B, 3 mouse, 4 keys 1, 5 keys 2; player 1 never gets B or the mouse, A needs a joystick, B two, the mouse [2627], never the other player's), F3 the sound driver 0 none / 1 blaster / 2 speaker (reloads the driver of the old setting through 1000:321c with interrupts off, then steps it), F4 smoothness 1..5 (5 = auto), F5 redefine keys (1000:92f0), F6 credits (1000:2a82), F7 joystick calibration (1000:2ab5). An 8-scan-code sequence at [0f6b] (pointer [0f73]) sets the debug flags [0f69] [0f6a]. Enter: control types into [2658] [265a], 6 (none) into [265c] [265e], input slots set (1000:2d00); if anything changed ([0f63]) and the current drive is C: or later, SETTINGS.DAT is rewritten; smoothness 5 runs the speed test (1000:3ad0). Out: CF clear = play, CF set = Esc (quit)

name: Menu_Credits
description: clears the screen (1000:0400), draws the 10 credit lines of the text table at [0f75], presents and waits for any released key ([107e])

name: Setup_CalibrateJoysticks
description: joystick calibration: prompts centre, left, right for joystick 1 (strings at [0ded] [0dd3] [0dda] [0ddf], the digit at [0df6]) and stores the X thresholds as midpoints: [28fd] = (centre + left) / 2, [28ff] = (centre + right) / 2; with two sticks ([2625] = 2) the same for joystick 2 into [2905] [2907]. Y is read but never kept. All registers kept

name: Joy_WaitButtonA
description: entry of 1000:2b93 with BL = 30h (joystick A's buttons)

name: Joy_WaitButtonB
description: entry of 1000:2b93 with BL = C0h (joystick B's buttons)

name: Joy_WaitButton
description: waits for the buttons in BL (bits of port 201h, active low) to be released, then shows the place-the-joystick prompt ([019a] = 0df8, position [0194] [0196], 1000:0c96) and polls (int 15h 84h, the result unused, then a present 1000:08bc) until one is pressed or Enter is released; then times all four axes (1000:2ffe). Out: AX, BX = joystick A X, Y; CX, DX = joystick B X, Y

name: Setup_ChooseGame
description: the data-set chooser: lists the GAME?.LVL files (find first/next, DTA at [0d7d], pattern [0d71]), loading each one's header through 1000:0f99 and printing its title; a cursor (1000:07e5, skipped when [26cf] = 1; colour cycle [0d70]) moves with the combined input [108b] (bits 20h/80h back, 10h/40h forward) until fire (08h); the chosen digit goes to [088d] and that GAME?.LVL is loaded again through 1000:0f99. Out: CF clear; CF set if no GAME?.LVL exists

name: Input_SetSlots
description: fills the four input slots [1083] [1085] [1087] [1089] from the control types [2658] [265a] [265c] [265e]: 4 keys 1 (1000:2dfa), 5 keys 2 (1000:2dfe), 3 mouse (1000:2e02), 1 joystick A (1000:2e6c, [108c] bit 0), 2 joystick B (1000:2eb3, [108c] bit 1), anything else none (1000:2ded). [108c] = which joysticks to time

name: Input_Read
description: once per frame: times the joysticks [108c] asks for (1 A: 1000:2f9e, 2 B: 1000:2fcc, 3 both: 1000:2ffe) into [108d] [108f] (A X, Y) and [1091] [1093] (B), buttons inverted into [1095]; then calls each slot with BX = the player's vehicle record ([2660] [2662] [2664] [2666]) and stores AL into the per-vehicle input bytes [137b] [14df] [1643] [17a7]; [108b] = player 1 | player 2 when [1080] = 0, else the byte [1080] points to. Input bits: 80h left, 40h right, 20h and 10h the two drive buttons, 08h fire/select. All registers kept (pusha)

name: Input_None
description: input slot for a vehicle with no device: AL = 0; while a race runs ([1082] != 0) the computer drives it (1000:5429, BX = the vehicle record)

name: Input_Keys1
description: input slot keys 1: AL = [107d] (the high byte of the key mask: scan codes [106c]..[1073])

name: Input_Keys2
description: input slot keys 2: AL = [107c] (the low byte: scan codes [1074]..[107b])

name: Input_Mouse
description: input slot mouse (int 33h 3): left button = 28h, right = 10h; X beyond 160 -/+ [290d] = 80h/40h, Y beyond 100 -/+ [290d] = 20h/10h; recentres the pointer (int 33h 4 to 160,100) when it moved. Out: AL. Reached only if the mouse flag [2627] is set, and its set-up (1000:3a44) is dead

name: Input_JoyA
description: input slot joystick A from the last timing: any button = 08h; X [108d] <= [28fd] = 80h, >= [28ff] = 40h; button 1 = 20h, button 2 = 10h, both = 30h. The Y comparisons with [2901] [2903] are made but their results are dropped (quirk: the stick's Y does nothing). Out: AL

name: Input_JoyB
description: the same as 1000:2e6c for joystick B: buttons [1095] bits 6-7, X [1091] against [2905] [2907], Y against [2909] [290b] dropped. Out: AL

name: Key_Irq
description: the IRQ 1 handler: reads the scan code, acknowledges it, tracks the E0 prefix in cs:[2f99], the last press [107f] and release [107e], Esc released -> [1096] = 1, the assigned keys bit mask [107c] (table of 16 scan codes at [106c]); specific EOI

name: Joy_TimeA
description: starts the game port's one-shots (out 201h) and counts, interrupts off, how long each of the four axis bits stays high (SI, DI, BX, BP) until joystick A's two axes drop or CX = 7530h polls pass. Out: SI = A X, DI = A Y, AL = port 201h (buttons, active low)

name: Joy_TimeB
description: the same loop ending on joystick B's axes. Out: SI = B X, DI = B Y, AL = the port

name: Joy_TimeBoth
description: the same loop ending when all four axes drop. Out: SI, DI = A X, Y; CX, DX = B X, Y; AL = the port

name: Race_ClearRegs
description: DS = 193c, then 1000:31b6 (zeroes the registers)

name: Race_Main
description: the race: set-up (1000:3030, 1000:37fc; CF there ends it), 1000:7a97, then per frame: Esc ([1096]) ends it; input (1000:2d5b); Space (key mask [107c] bit 1) pauses (1000:35f0); the game step (1000:4aee); end of race when [26c6] >= 2 and a countdown [26cc] runs out (not in mode [2656] = 2, which ends at once); draw (1000:90c5); per vehicle (BX = 0, 164h, .. 42Ch) 1000:7429, 1000:73e7 when its state [bx+12ae] != 0, 1000:51b2. Every [263a] (smoothness) frames it waits until the tick counter cs:[4ade] passes the limit [263c + smoothness], presents (1000:92bc) and restarts the counter. At the end: a sound (driver AH = 5, AL = 10h) if [bx+1250], 1000:7af8, 100 frames of 1000:855a with presents, driver AH = 8 and 6; then the finishing order [2678]..[267e] fixed up from [2635] and [2630], the fade out (1000:327a) and a change of directory to [261c] (the parent)

name: Sys_WaitTick
description: waits until the tick counter cs:[4ade] (advanced by the timer handler 1000:489c) changes. All registers but AL kept

name: Dead_WaitRetrace
description: unreferenced: waits for the end and then the start of a vertical retrace on 3DAh

name: Dead_SetTextMode
description: unreferenced: saves the video mode in [2645] and sets mode 3

name: Dead_RestoreMode
description: unreferenced: sets the video mode saved in [2645]

name: Sys_ReadCrtcBase
description: [2643] = the CRTC base port from the BIOS data area (0040:0063). Keeps ES, SI

name: Sys_ClearRegs
description: zeroes EAX..EDI (32-bit: needs a 386) and their 16-bit halves, CLD, CLC, STI

name: Sys_CodeCardCheck
description: the start-up protection: reads FONT.BIN (name [1241], open mode C0h, handle not checked) whole (up to FFFFh bytes) into 2424:0000 and far-calls 2424:0000 with AX = 0; FONT.BIN is code (the code-card question). Out: AX as FONT.BIN returns it, 0 = passed (Start exits otherwise)

name: Snd_LoadDriver
description: loads DRIVERn.BIN, n = '0' + [0f64] patched into the name at [11e0], into 2424:0000 (over FONT.BIN), cs:[3279] = 0 meanwhile; driver AH = 0 (init) with DX = 388h (the AdLib port) and BX, CX = DS:[000b], DS:[000d] (read through cs:93cb/93cd); then driver AH = 2 with CX = 4287h until it returns AL = 0; cs:[3279] = 1 (the timer handler calls the driver only then)

name: Pal_FadeOut
description: once (flag [26ce] set to 1): reads the DAC (int 10h 1017h) into 6d78:0000 and runs 126 steps of 1000:32ae, every second one lowering all 768 values by one, each writing the whole DAC; no retrace waits. All registers kept

name: Pal_FadeOutStep
description: one fade-out step, CX = the step: on even CX lowers each nonzero byte of 6d78:0000..02ff by one; then (shared tail with 1000:3303) writes 256 colours from DS:SI to the DAC (3C8h/3C9h)

name: Pal_FadeIn
description: only after a fade out ([26ce] = 1, cleared): zeroes the working palette 6d78:0300..05ff and runs 128 steps of 1000:3303 towards the target palette at 6d78:0000. All registers kept

name: Pal_FadeInStep
description: one fade-in step, CX = the step: on even CX raises each byte of the working palette (DS:0300, DS = 6d78) that is below its target (DS:0000) by one; writes the working palette to the DAC

name: Unpack_Decode
description: the COMPRESS.PI* (and other packed files) decoder: from 6d78:c000 into 6d78:0000. Flag bits MSB first from control bytes (a set carry as the end marker): 0 = a literal byte, 1 = a code byte: FFh ends; 80h..FEh short back-references (length from bits 5-6, distance from 5 bits and the next byte); below 80h: long back-references, runs of one byte, runs that count up from the previous byte (each byte + 1) and long literal runs, with lengths in extra bytes. Out: BH = the output size's high byte, CL its low byte (BL = 0)

name: Unpack_SwapState
description: exchanges AL with cs:[3544] and the flags with cs:[3545]: called in pairs around each code of 1000:3333 so that the control byte and its flags survive the code's use of AL

name: Unpack_LoadSeries
description: loads numbered packed files: ES:DI.. of 6d78 is zeroed (FFFFh bytes) first; for n = 0, 1, ..: the name's last character at DS:SI becomes '0' + n, the file is read whole into 6d78:c000, decoded (1000:3333) and the output (rounded down to 256 bytes) copied to DX:0000, DX advancing 0c00h (48 KB) per file; stops at the first file that does not open. In: DS:SI name, DX first segment

name: Sys_Ret
description: a bare ret: the null entry of the terrain and vehicle-state handler tables (193c:26e9.., 193c:278f)

name: File_SaveScreen
description: debug: bumps the digit [292d] of the name at [2929] and writes 6d78:0000 (FFFAh bytes, the frame buffer) to that new file. All registers kept

name: Race_Pause
description: pause: driver AH = 8 and 6; looks the paused position up in the 12-byte cheat records at [1bdb]..[1fcb] (theme [28bf], track [28c0], X and Y within 24 of vehicle 1's [bx+125c] [bx+1268]) and applies the record's effect 0..9 (e.g. 1: the race won, finishing order [2678].. set, [26c6] = 4; 2-4: vehicle fields [bx+127c] [bx+127e] [bx+12a2]; 5, 6, 9: flags [2915] [2917] [2919] [291b]; 7: [bx+12f9] = 0; 8: [bx+129c] = 800h; 0: [0406] - 1), flashing the screen white when one matched; then draws the pause picture into 6d78 (1000:9289), presents, waits for a key or 8Ch ticks ([261f]), redraws and waits for a key. With the debug flag (DS:0f69 read as cs:[a329]) and theme != 9: F12 saves the screen (1000:35bf), held key-mask combinations 0600h / 0300h apply effects 9 / 1

name: Race_Setup
description: starts with 255 nops (37fc..38fa); then [2630] = 0, smoothness at least 1, CRTC base (1000:319f), the vehicles' indices [137c].. = 3, 2, 1, 0, [2682] = FFFFh; the track's files (1000:3b50, 1000:3c09, 1000:458b, 1000:482f, 1000:4611, 1000:45e5; CF from any = fail); fade out, A000 cleared, overscan colour 0 (int 10h 1001h); for data set GAME1 on themes 2 and 3, the tile words of the two blocks 3b78:0000 and 4478:0000 (4706h words each) in a theme's range get bit 15; first draw (1000:90c5), 1000:4758 (CF = fail), fade in, driver AH = 7. Out: CF clear; on failure 1000:7af8, driver AH = 8, 6, AX = 1, CF set

name: Joy_Detect
description: [2625] = the number of joysticks: BIOS int 15h 84h DX = 1 reads the axes; A counts when AX > 5 or BX >= 5, B when CX > 5 or DX >= 5; 0 if the BIOS call fails

name: Dead_MouseInit
description: unreferenced: resets the mouse driver (int 33h 0), hides the pointer, limits it to 0..319 x 0..199, centres it and sets the mouse flag [2627] = 1 (0 without a driver); without it the mouse slot (1000:2e02) is never offered

name: Dead_SbDspReset
description: only called by the dead 1000:3a8d: pulses the Sound Blaster DSP reset at [2641] + 6

name: Dead_SbDetect
description: unreferenced: Sound Blaster detection: from the base [2641] in steps of 10h up to 270h resets the DSP and waits for AAh on base + 0Ah; [262d] = 1 if found, else 0; AX = [262d]. Since nothing calls it, [262d] keeps its initial value

name: Sys_SpeedTest
description: the CPU benchmark behind smoothness AUTO: CRTC base from 0040:0063 (into [2643]); with interrupts off, after a retrace ends, counts loop passes (each a word written to A000:0030 plus a 1000-count load) until the next retrace starts; [263a] = 4 below 13 passes, 3 below 20, 2 below 24, else 1. Keeps AX..DX, ES

name: Track_SetNames
description: changes directory to GAME1 ([042a]); patches the theme digit ([28bf] + '0') into the per-theme file names and theme + track ([28c0]) into ROUNDnm.MAP and ROUNDnmB.BRK; reads the .BRK file (0200h bytes) to [195b] and the theme's .LEV (80h bytes) to [1b5b], pointers to them (0 if absent) in [28bb] [28b9]; [28bd] = the theme's terrain handler table from [26d7]; theme 9 clears [13b2] [1516] [167a] and sets [27b5]

name: Race_LoadTrack
description: the race set-up, called once per race by 1000:37fc: resets the race globals (193c:264e/2650 camera speeds = 8, 26c6, 2911, 2913, 26b4.., 2915/2917/2919, 291b = 3, 291d, 2682 = ffff; 26c8 from the per-track word table 2419 indexed by [28c0]); reads STRT_POS.BIN into 1eab, CHEATS.BIN into 1bdb and ROUNDnm.MAP into 2963 (int 21h 3Dh with AL = c0h; ROUND11.MAP's digits patched elsewhere); [2652] = the largest byte of the map's second kilobyte (the progress index; [2654] = half); the start grid from STRT_POS (4 bytes per track: (theme-1)*16 + (track-1)*4, x + 14h, y - 0Ah; each vehicle +1Ah per bit of its grid slot word [bx+137c]) into the position words 125c/125e and 1268/126a, the camera [264a]/[2646], [264c]/[2648] = start - 250 wrapped by c00h; the handling of the four vehicles from the theme's 9-word row of 193c:252a (12h bytes per theme): top speed 129c, reverse limit 12a0, acceleration 12a2, braking 12a4, drag 12a6, grip 127c/127e, and the slide rates [28c2]/[28c4]; computer cars scaled by the race number [28c1] (tables 23dc by driver [2668+i], 2462 by race) and per theme, or by the handicap byte [2668+i] when DS:08a2 (read as cs:9c62) is set; the human/computer flags (12eb = 1 when the control type in 2658.. is 6), the order list 2670../2678.. and the rest of every record cleared (state 12ae = 0Ah, the 12fd and 135d arrays = ffff); then ROUNDnBR.CT into 6d78:0000 and the 32 x 32 map expanded through it (tile index & 3Fh, 72 bytes per tile = 6 rows of 6 words) into a 192 x 192 word grid, rows 0-95 at 3b78:0000 and 96-191 at 4478:0000 (384 bytes a row); carry set if a file is missing; ends by re-filling the input slots (1000:2d00)

name: Track_LoadColDir
description: reads the theme's ROUNDn.COL into 193c:3163 and ROUNDn.DIR into 193c:35e3 (whole files, int 21h 3Dh AL = c0h); carry set on an open failure; registers kept

name: Track_LoadTiles
description: the theme's tile graphics: 1000:45ef, then (if no carry) 1000:4808 copies the first 256 bytes of the result into 193c:3ee3; carry clear

name: Track_LoadTileGfx
description: loads ROUNDnBR.PR0.. (193c:11e6) through the packed-file loader 1000:3547 into the buffer at 1b78:0000; registers kept, carry clear

name: Car_LoadGfx
description: loads ROUNDnBR.VH0.. (193c:11f3) through 1000:3547 into 1b78, then splits it: theme 9 ([28bf] = 9): 3840h bytes to 4d78:0000 and 1f40h to 5d78:0000 (40 x 40 frames) and the mirrored frames by 1000:46f6; other themes: 1440h bytes to 4d78:0000, 1b00h to 5d78:0000 (24 x 24 frames), mirrors by 1000:4696, and for theme 8 the first 1400h bytes of 5d78 copied into 193c:5ee3; carry clear

name: Car_MirrorFrames24
description: in 4d78 (DS = ES): from the eight 24 x 24 vehicle frames at 4d78:0000 builds at 1440h eight frames flipped top to bottom, then seven and eight frames flipped left to right, completing the full turn of directions from the drawn quarter; no inputs

name: Car_MirrorFrames40
description: the same as 1000:4696 for theme 9's 40 x 40 frames: flipped copies from 31d8h written at 3840h in 4d78

name: Pal_LoadRound
description: reads ROUNDn.PAL (193c:1200, 300h bytes) into 6d78:0000; for theme 3, track 2 or 1 ([28c0]), copies three colours (entries 219-221 or 235-237) over entries 251-253; carry set on an error

name: Track_CopyTileTable
description: copies 80h words from 1b78:0000 (the unpacked tile file's head) to 193c:3ee3; registers kept

name: Gfx_LoadBits
description: loads ..\BITSFILE.PH0 (193c:1231) through 1000:3547 into 1b78 and copies its first 6e00h bytes to 193c:3fe3..ade3 (the race's small graphics, inferred); carry clear

name: Timer_Measure
description: the frame in PIT counts between two retrace starts: AX = CX = first - second count, DX = the second

name: Timer_Irq
description: the IRQ 0 handler, locked to the retrace: unless IRQ 2 works (cs:[4a92]), PIT to FFFFh, wait for the retrace, reload [2614]; counts [28f7], [0002], [261f], the 32-frame blink [26d0]/[26cf]; the sound driver's tick (AH = 3) while cs:[3279]; chains to the old vector [260c]

name: Timer_Install
description: once ([2618]): measures the frame into [2612], reload [2614] = it - 96h, [2610] = 123428h / it, saves the IRQ 0 vector in [260c], installs Timer_Irq, loads the PIT

name: Timer_Remove
description: the old IRQ 0 vector back, the PIT at 65536 ([2618] left set)

name: Irq_Install
description: Timer_Install, Retrace_IrqInstall, the IRQ 1 vector saved in [2925] and Key_Irq installed

name: Sys_RemoveIrqs
description: the timer back (1000:4966), int 09h from [2925]; DOS's time and date set again from the real-time clock (int 1Ah 02h, 04h, BCD through 1000:4adf, int 21h 2Dh, 2Bh) because the 70 Hz chaining ran the BIOS clock fast; the driver stopped (AH = 6); the retrace interrupt removed (1000:4a6c)

name: Retrace_IrqInstall
description: saves CRTC register 11h in cs:[4a8d] and the IRQ 2 vector in cs:[4a8e], installs Retrace_Irq, enables the VGA's retrace interrupt; cs:[4ade] = FFh

name: Retrace_IrqRemove
description: the old IRQ 2 vector back, CRTC register 11h rewritten as the install writes it

name: Retrace_Irq
description: the IRQ 2 handler: if 3C2h bit 7 (the VGA's retrace interrupt) clears and acknowledges it, cs:[4a92] = 1, counts cs:[4ade]; else chains to the old vector

name: Sys_BcdToBin
description: AL (BCD) -> AL (binary); BX and AH used

name: Car_StepAll
description: the vehicles' control step, once per game step from 1000:3039: for each record (bx = 0..42ch, stride 164h): theme 9's special case; the race start (all speeds 127a zero and the countdown [26c6]); in two-player mode ([2656] = 2) the point's end ([26b4] score, re-seeding the order list 2678.. and [26c2], [26be]/[26c0] the banner); with state 12ae = 0 and the car active (124c), its input byte 137b (80h left, 40h right, 20h accelerate, 10h brake, 08h fire) steers the heading 1278 (0..ffh, centred to a multiple of 10h when not steering) by the turn rate (1000:4edc), accelerates 127a by 12a2 (six times as fast for a computer car behind the leader: [262f]) up to 129c, brakes by 12a4 down to 12a0, else drag 12a6 towards 0; both pedals together or fire (joystick and mouse) start a hop (label 4f17); then velocity (1000:525e) in player order 2660..2666, 1000:5921, 1000:5be7 per car; then the camera: the target [2646]/[2648] = the followed car (27b7 by [27b5]) minus its look-ahead 1262/126e, or in two-player mode the midpoint of the two (too far apart: [2911] = 1); [264a]/[264c] move towards it by at most [264e]/[2650] (wrapping at c00h); when the camera rests the flags 137e/14e2/1646/17aa = 1

name: Car_TurnRate
description: CX = the turn step of vehicle bx: [bx+129a] (2 for themes 6 and 7, else 3, set in 1000:3c09); on theme 7 one more for a computer car (12eb = 1), halved at speeds of 320h and up for a human one

name: Car_StepAll_Fire
description: an inner label of 1000:4aee (reached by its jumps; not called): fire pressed; when the race is not running ([26c6] = 2) or [2915] = 1 back to the speed code, else on to the hop (4f17)

name: Car_StepAll_Hop
description: an inner label of 1000:4aee: start a hop if allowed ([2919] = 1, or theme 7), the car is not already hopping (13a4 = 0) and is human (1250): the driver's effect AH = 5, AL = 0Eh; 1394 = 1, 1396 = 0, the hop timer 13a4 = 60, 139a = 139e = 10; the hop's velocity from the heading's sine table (193c:10a0) and the car's sub-pixel position into 13a0/1398 (x) and 13a2/139c (y); continues the loop at 4fd1

name: Car_HopStep
description: vehicle bx's hop: decrements the timer 13a4; while it is 28h or more, moves the hop's x (13a0 fraction, 1398) and y (13a2, 139c) by six steps of 1000:87f3 each and counts 1396 up to 5, 139a and 139e down; nothing when 13a4 = 0

name: Car_Velocity
description: vehicle bx (active, state 0, 12d6 <= 0, 1380 = 0): the wanted velocity 1270 (x) and 1274 (y) = speed 127a times the sine and cosine of the heading (signed bytes at 193c:10a0, 32 directions); the actual velocity 1272/1276 follows within a slip threshold DX and step CX from the grip 127c/127e (half as much again for a computer car behind the leader, [262f]), or the theme's slide rates [28c2]/[28c4] while the timers 1284/1286 run; 1282 = 1 while sliding; look-ahead 1262 = 80h, 126e = 64h; a sliding human player 1 plays the skid effect (AH = 5, AL = 5) when sound is on ([0f64] = 1), not on themes 2 and 8, on theme 6 at most every 50 steps ([28fb])

name: Ai_Drive
description: a computer driver's input for vehicle bx, returned in AL and in 137b: the wanted heading from the tile's direction (12da low nibble, & 7 on theme 2; with 12de bit 1 through the lane table 193c:191b by 12e0, bit 0 turns it round) through 193c:18fb, steer left (80h) or right (40h) when the heading 1278 differs by 3 or more; the speed rule from the per-progress byte at [28bb] + 12e3 (high nibble 0: full throttle, 1: a speed limit (low nibble x 128 + 380h, adjusted by race 28c1 and theme 7) braking (10h) above it, 2: caps 129c at low nibble x 64 + 600h; otherwise lift while steering); 129c restored from 129e; fire (08h) always set; called through input slot 1000:2ded when [1082] is set

name: Car_MoveProbe
description: one vehicle (bx = record offset from 193c:124c, stride 164h), state 0 only: integrates velocity [1272]/[1276] plus fractions [1258]/[1264] into the candidate position [125e]/[126a] (8.8 fixed point, wrapped to the 0..0c00h world), looks the tile up (Track_TileAt: [12cc] tile, [12de] tile flags, [12ce] in-tile cell, checkpoint byte from the second map layer) and its surface class (Track_SurfaceAt -> [12da]/[12dc]); a solid cell probes the four corners +-8 px and sets the blocked flags [12c4]/[12c6] (x) and [12c8]/[12ca] (y) and the bounce request [12a8]; a new checkpoint moves [12e3] into [12e1] and sets [12e5]; checkpoint 0ffh (off the track) saves the position in [12ba]/[12bc] and sets state 0dh; theme 3 (193c:28bf) uses the per-tile layer flag 193c:25cc and [1388] (bridges), [1390]/[13ac] a 50-frame stuck timer; sounds AH=5 AL=6 (AL=4 on theme 2) for the player ([1250] != 0); es and dx kept

name: Track_SurfaceAt
description: the surface byte under a vehicle: 6 x 6 grid of 16-px cells per tile at 193c:35e3 + tile [12cc] * 24h, cell from [12ce] (bh = x/8, bl = y/8, halved); old [12da] -> [12dc], the new byte -> [12da] (top bits = terrain class, low bits = flags); flags (carry) preserved through pushf/popf, ax trashed, cx kept

name: Track_TileAt
description: ax = world x, dx = world y (0..0bffh): tile = (y/96)*32 + x/96; map byte at 193c:2963+tile gives tile number (low 6 bits, out in si) and orientation flags (top 2 bits, out in di); second map layer 193c:2d63+tile (checkpoint number) out in es; in-tile 8-px cell out in cx (ch = x/8, cl = y/8); carry = the cell's bit in the 18-byte (12 x 12) solidity mask at 193c:3163 + tile * 18; ax, bx, dx kept

name: Coll_CarsAll
description: the six pairs of the four racers (record offsets in 193c:2660/2662/2664/2666) through Coll_CarPair, the pair in 193c:27b1 and 27b3; bx kept

name: Coll_CarPair
description: vehicle bx's candidate position is recomputed (as in Car_MoveProbe), then cars 193c:27b1 and 27b3, both active ([124c]) and in state 0 or 2: if within 16 px on both axes the 17 x 17 collision shape 193c:17da (index from the halved offsets) gives an angle; if one is in state 2 (just respawned) both are pushed apart at 40h/-40h; else the relative velocity is projected on the angle (sine table 193c:10a0, 256 steps, cosine 40h before), floored at 1f4h and applied as an impulse to [1272]/[1276] of both with the bounce flag [12ac]; theme 6 (193c:28bf) and a hard hit: both cars are knocked off the track (state 0dh, AH=5 AL=1); sound AH=5 AL=3; clobbers bx

name: Car_Physics
description: one vehicle's move for the frame (bx): a pending impulse [12ac] recomputes the candidate position; Car_MoveProbe, Terrain_Dispatch; on a blocked move ([12fb], [12a8]) the velocity is reversed on the blocked axes (halved when [138a]), a stuck counter [12aa] (20 frames with [12eb]) puts the car off the track (state 0dh); in states 0, 2, 0eh the candidate position is committed to [125c]/[1268] and fractions; the tile's surface flag (193c:28b9 + tile, kept in [12e0]) decides whether the position is a safe respawn point ([12f1]/[12f3], previous in [12f5]/[12f7]); [138a] = 1; with 193c:2919 = 1 or theme 7 calls 1000:79fd

name: Terrain_Dispatch
description: in two-player (193c:2656 = 2) both cars sinking (state 1) or in a hole (state 5) ends the race (193c:2913 = 1); state 0: terrain class = [12da] >> 5 (themes 1, 2, 3, 6) or >> 4 (others) into [12d0] (previous in [12d2]), handler from the theme's table (193c:28bd -> 193c:26e9..) called through 1000:5eea unless airborne ([12d6]); theme 2 with flags 18h adds the current (Terrain_Current); then checkpoint progress against the lap list 193c:1feb[theme][track 193c:28c0] (index [12e7], lap-to-go [12ed]): a crossing forward of the finish decrements [12ed] (AH=5 AL=2), backwards increments it (max 9), a jump of more than 193c:2654 checkpoints in one-player is a short cut (state 0dh, AH=5 AL=1); theme 2 track 1 with the player ahead sets 193c:26c6 = 2; theme 2 also runs Terrain_Plughole

name: Terrain_Floor
description: class 0 (all themes, also 2.7 3.0 4.15 5.13 6.5 8.3): clears [1390]; coming down from a raised level ([138e] != 0) sets level 0 and a jump with vertical speed [12d4] = (vx^2 + vy^2 of the high bytes)/15 + 4; on theme 1 leaving class 4 or 3 jumps with /7 + 4 or /12 + 8

name: Terrain_FallOff
description: theme 8 class 1: off the edge: position saved in [12ba]/[12bc], state 0dh, timer [1382] = 46h

name: Terrain_Boost
description: theme 8 class 2: two-stage ([1390] 1 then 2); on the second, a vehicle moving right or still ([1272] >= 0) gains 0c8h of x speed

name: Terrain_Rough
description: theme 5 class 3, theme 6 class 4: a jump when leaving a raised level (/15 + 4); otherwise velocity halved (except coming from class 3 on theme 5, class 4 elsewhere) with sound AH=5 AL=6 for the player; caps the speed [127a] at 200h, then asks the driver AH=0Ah AL=6 (result unused)

name: Terrain_Current
description: themes 8 (classes 6-8) and 9 (3-5), and theme 2 when the surface has flags 18h: a flow pushes the vehicle: direction from 193c:18fb by the surface's low bits (theme 2: 3 bits) or, with tile flag 2 in [12de], from 193c:191b by [12e0] bits 5-6; tile flag 1 turns it 180 degrees; components from the sine table 193c:10a0, each clamped to [12a0]..[129c] and added to [1272]/[1276]; [127a] capped at 100h

name: Terrain_Plughole
description: theme 2 only, state 0: inside the box around world (650h, 0b70h) the vehicle is pulled toward that point, harder near it; within 12 px of it: sinking (state 1), [1382] = 46h, candidate position = the centre, [12be]/[12c0] = quarter steps toward it for [12c2] = 4 frames

name: Terrain_Splash
description: theme 2 class 1: requests the splash/puff effect ([128a] = 1; drawn by the effect code at 1000:8139)

name: Terrain_Ramp
description: theme 2 class 6: on the ground ([12d6] = 0) a jump with [12d4] = max(speed^2, 1ch)/8 + 5, [12d8] = 0

name: Terrain_Bump
description: theme 2 class 3: unless coming from class 6, a speed^2 of at least 0eh makes a jump ([12d4] = max(speed^2, 1ch)/10 + 5)

name: Terrain_Hole
description: theme 1 class 1, theme 3 class 2, theme 5 class 4: if the vehicle can fall ([12f9]): state 1, [12b0] = 0, candidate position snapped to the 16-px cell centre, [12be]/[12c0] quarter steps for [12c2] = 4 frames, timers [1282]-[1288] and all velocities ([1270]-[1276]) cleared

name: Terrain_HoleKeepSpeed
description: theme 4 class 3, theme 8 class 10, theme 9 class 7: as Terrain_Hole but the velocities are left alone

name: Terrain_FloorSkid
description: theme 1 class 2, 3.1, 4.1, 5.14, 6.1: as Terrain_Floor (jump off a raised level, theme 1 ramps) and, when not jumping, a skid ([1282]) requests a skid mark ([1288] = 1)

name: Terrain_Splashy
description: theme 4 class 2, 5.2, 8.9, 9.6: jump off a raised level; when moving ([127a] != 0) requests the splash/puff effect ([128a] = 1) and plays AH=5 AL=12h for the player

name: Terrain_Wall
description: theme 1 classes 3 and 4: entered from class 0 or 2 it counts as class 0 and the vehicle bounces back on both axes ([12a8], [12c4], [12c8] = 1)

name: Terrain_Slick
description: theme 1 class 5, theme 6 class 3: grip lost for 20 frames ([1284] = 14h; Car_Handling then uses the low grip 193c:28c2/28c4), sound AH=5 AL=12h for the player

name: Terrain_SlickB
description: theme 7 class 15: jump off a raised level, then the second low-grip timer [1286] = 14h

name: Terrain_RampBig
description: theme 5 class 1, 8.4, 9.1: jump off a raised level (/15 + 6); unless coming from class 6 a jump of speed^2/9 + 0bh (theme 2) or + 2

name: Terrain_RampSmall
description: theme 1 class 6, 2.2, 4.4, 5.15, 6.2, 8.5, 9.2: jump off a raised level; a speed^2 of at least 0eh jumps max(speed^2, 1ch)/7 (+ 7 on theme 2)

name: Terrain_RampSteep
description: theme 7 class 14: jump off a raised level; unless coming from class 6 a jump of speed^2/5 + 4

name: Terrain_None
description: theme 1 class 7: a lone ret (nothing happens)

name: Terrain_Edge
description: theme 3 class 7, and Car_MoveProbe when the previous surface had flag 10h: leaving it jumps (speed^2/12 + 4), [1384] = 1, sound AH=5 AL=1 for the player

name: Terrain_Levels
description: themes 4 and 5 classes 5-12 (and 13, 14 on theme 4): stepped heights: level = class - 4 (13 -> -1, 14 -> 4 with a jump); up by more than 2 levels is a wall (four corner probes with Track_TileAt, blocked flags, bounce [12a8]); otherwise [138e] = level, down by 2 or more (or onto level -1) jumps with speed^2/18 + 4

name: Terrain_LevelsB
description: theme 6 classes 6-7, theme 7 classes 1-8: as Terrain_Levels with level = class (class 8 counts as 2) and jumps of speed^2/15 + 4

name: Terrain_Layer
description: theme 3 class 5: surface flag 10h puts the vehicle on the upper layer ([1388] = 1, [1386] = 0), else the lower ([1388] = 0, [1386] = 1); with the per-tile flags 193c:25cc this lets cars pass over and under bridges (inferred)

name: Car_Warp
description: vehicle state 0eh and theme 3 class 4: the warp hole, sub-state [1382]: 0 finds the entry for the vehicle's tile in the list 193c:22e1 (tile x, tile y, minimum lap position [12e7], exit x, y, heading, group; else falls into a hole, state 5, if [12f9]), queues the car in its group's ring at 193c:2684.. (count 2684, head 2686, tail 2688, wait 268a, slots 268c), state 4, centres it; 1: exit position [1260]/[126c], heading [1278], speed [127a] = [129c], velocity from the sine table, most fields reset, AI buffers [12fd] (30h words) and [135d] (0fh) set to -1, hidden ([124c] = 0), state 0eh; 2: two-player waits up to 40 frames (then 193c:2911 = 1); 3: moves toward the exit 8 * 193c:263a px per frame; at it and first in the queue: visible, airborne ([12d6] = 1, [12d4] = 8); 4: drives (Car_Drive 1000:7d73 with es = 6d78) until 50 px from the exit, dequeues, state 0; ds, es, si, di kept

name: Car_Respawn
description: vehicle state 7, theme 9 class 15: back on the track: themes 2 and 8 count [1382] down first; position = the centre of the last safe tile ([12f1]/[12f3]) plus the tile's offset from 193c:1fcb (by the surface byte at 193c:28b9 + tile), heading from its bits 5-6 and the tile flags, moved 12 px sideways (player 1 one way, the others the other), checkpoint and lap position [12e7] recomputed from 193c:1feb; state 2, [1380] = 1, velocities, timers and AI buffers reset, 193c:26bc-26c2 cleared, sound AH=5 AL=9 for the player, 193c:264e/2650 = 8, the surface read twice, themes 4 and 5 set the height level [138e]; two-player gives both cars the smaller laps-to-go [12ed]; track 16h (193c:28c1) on tile 4 moves the safe point up 60h first (a special case)

name: Car_SinkStep
description: per vehicle (bx) from the race step 1000:3039 (theme 9: only bx = 0): counts the animation frame [12b0]; in states 1, 4, 5 (sinking, warp, hole) moves the position by [12be]/[12c0] while [12c2] lasts

name: Car_StepAirAndPoints
description: once per vehicle per game step (bx = vehicle record offset 0..42c, called from the race loop at 1000:309c): theme 9 counts the time limit [26c8] down and puts vehicle 0 into state 10h when it runs out; counts the trail and ripple timers [bx+12b2], [bx+12b4] down; integrates the height [bx+12d6] with the vertical speed [bx+12d4] (gravity per theme from the word table 193c:24ff), bounces on landing ([bx+12d8]) with a landing effect (driver AH=5, AL=4 or 7 by theme), theme 2 sets the ripple request [bx+128c], a pending hit [bx+1384] becomes state 0Dh; in two-player head-to-head ([2656] = 2) runs the point exchange: after a point ([26b8] scorer, [26ba] a 40h-step pause flashing the leader) both players restart in state 0Dh, the point bar [26b4] (0..8) moves to the scorer, and at 0 or 8 the winner [26c4] is set, the race ends ([26c6] = 2) with effect 10h; calls 1000:78f8

name: Race_AwardPoint
description: two-player point when [2911] = 1 (called by the race frame 1000:90c5): picks the scorer (bx) and the loser (si) from the vehicle that dropped out ([2682], set by state 4) or from the race positions [bx+12ef] of the two players [2660]/[2662]; clears the loser's entries at 193c:2684+[138c], sets [26b8] = scorer, resets its height and speeds, copies its checkpoint [12f1]/[12f3] to the loser, scorer state 0Bh (spins), loser state 0Ch; [264e] = [2650] = 4; stops driver channels 0..8 (AH=8, AL=n), waits for a retrace (1000:3165) and plays effect 0Ah (AH=5)

name: Race_RespawnPlayers
description: when [2913] is set (both players fell at once, 1000:5e4e) or from 1000:7429: if only one of the two players is in state 1 or 5 the other is switched off ([si+124c] = 0); otherwise the player further back gets the leader's checkpoint ([12f1], [12f3], [1388]), both are made active in state 7 (respawn) and [2911], [2913] are cleared

name: Coll_ShellHitsCar
description: for vehicle bx (if it can be hit, [bx+124e]): every other vehicle's shell in flight ([si+1394] set, timer [si+13a4] >= 28h) within 12 pixels of bx's position ends, bx records its position in [12ba]/[12bc] and goes to state 0Dh (hit), effect 1 (AH=5) if visible

name: Copy_Patch32
description: patches the copy loop at 1000:91a4 to move doublewords (66 a5, movsd, written over its four movsw) and sets cs:[92d9] = 40h, cs:[92dc] = a566h; all registers kept

name: Snd_InitEngines
description: at the start of a race: with a sound device other than type 1 ([0f64] != 1) sets the engine tones of driver channels 0 and 1 (AH=0Eh, CX=32h); with type 1 writes the four engine channel blocks in the driver's segment directly (2424:0008 + 10h*n, bytes +2, +9, +0a, +0b; values by theme [28bf])

name: Snd_SilenceEngines
description: silences the engine notes: with device type [0f64] != 1 driver AH=10h with CX=0 on channels 0 and 1; with type 1 instead zeroes the speed [127a] of all four vehicles (the engine note is computed from it; all registers kept)

name: Snd_UpdateEngines
description: once per presented frame (end of 1000:90c5): nothing while any vehicle is in state 0Bh; device type 1 ([0f64] = 1): per vehicle (four, two in head-to-head) a pitch from abs(speed [127a]) / 10 (+30h airborne, 14h for [1382], 0Ah when not visible [1250] = 0) plus jitter from 1000:7cae, written into the driver's channel block (2424:0008 + 10h*n, +0a pitch, +0c 98h on / 91h off) and effect 40h+n started (AH=0Ah test, AH=5 play) when sounding; cs:[7af5] is the effect number counter, cs:[7af6] the last pitch (written only); other devices: tail at 7c4e calls 1000:7c5b for vehicle 0 (channel 0) and falls into it for vehicle 1 (channel 1)

name: Snd_SetEngineTone
description: AL = driver channel, BX = vehicle: tone = 2000h - (2 * abs(speed [127a]) capped at 7ffh, + 7f7h airborne, fixed 100h when [1382] or not visible) + jitter (-8..7 from 1000:7cae); driver AH=0Eh with CX = tone; second entry of 1000:7b46's tail (reached by fall-through)

name: Snd_Random
description: pseudo-random AX from a 4-byte state in the code segment (cs:7cdb..7cde, read and written as three overlapping words at 7cdb, 7cdc, 7cdd with xor, add and add-with-carry constants); used only for the engine-note jitter

name: Car_DrawAndRunStates
description: per presented frame, inside the race frame between the map and the foreground tiles: shadows (1000:7e5c) of active airborne vehicles, ripples (1000:8386) and skid marks or wake (1000:8083) of all four, shells (1000:8712) where [13a4] is set, then each vehicle's state handler through the word table 193c:278f indexed by [bx+12ae] (state 0Eh runs even when inactive), then the position number over finished vehicles or at the race end (1000:9076; not in theme 9 or head-to-head)

name: Car_Draw
description: draws vehicle bx (pusha): skipped (and [1250] visible = 0) for the hidden vehicle [2621]; otherwise [1250] = 1, the frame from the heading [1278] (32 directions), lifted by the height [12d6] (not in theme 8), relative to the camera [264a]/[264c] with the world's wrap at C00h; 24 x 24 frames from segment 4d78 recoloured by [1252] (1000:8c6a); theme 9 draws vehicle 0 as 40 x 40 frames plain; theme 8 also draws the 1000:843d overlay unless the state is 2 or 0Dh. The handler for states 0, 0Bh, 0Ch

name: Car_DrawShadow
description: vehicle bx's shadow: the same frame as 1000:7d73 offset down-right by the height [12d6], drawn in colour 0 (1000:8c3c) from segment 4d78; none in theme 8, in theme 9 only vehicle 0 (40 x 40)

name: Car_StateAnim5
description: vehicle state 5: if [12c2] just draws the vehicle; else plays the frame sequence of 193c:2855 (step durations against the counter [12b0]; frames at +12h; -2 = no frame, -1 = end) drawn with 1000:7fe8, effect 8 at step 4; at the end step [12b6] = 0 and state 7 (respawn)

name: Car_StateAnim4
description: vehicle state 4 (knocked out): notes the first such vehicle in [2682] for the two-player point; if [12c2] draws the vehicle; else plays the sequence 193c:2879 (frames at +12h) like 1000:7efa, effect 8 at step 4; at the end the vehicle is switched off ([124c] = 0), state 0Eh, [1382] = [1380] = 1, [137e] = 0

name: Car_DrawEffect24
description: SI = frame: draws a 24 x 24 frame (frame * 240h) of the effect sprites in segment 5d78 at vehicle bx's position, recoloured by [1252]; clipped

name: Car_DrawEffect40
description: SI = frame (5 subtracted above 4): draws a 40 x 40 frame (frame * 640h) from segment 5d78 at vehicle bx's position, plain; theme 9's version of 1000:7fe8

name: Car_DrawTrail
description: vehicle bx's skid marks or wake: a ring of eight 12-byte entries at [bx+12fd] (two points, a frame, a sprite) with the cursor [bx+1296]; draws both points of each live entry as 8 x 8 frames (1000:8cd0) and ages them each time [12b2] runs out (frame 8 = gone); then, every three steps, adds an entry at two points beside the vehicle's tail (heading [1278] + 80h, +-1Eh, through the 256-entry signed sine table 193c:10a0, divided by 16) when skidding ([1284] with speed [1272]/[1276]) or on request [1288] / [128a] (three sprite sets 43e3, 41e3, 3fe3 in DS); theme 2 sways the points with [128e]/[1290] and [1292]/[1294]

name: Car_StateSplash
description: vehicle states 2 and 0Dh: plays the sequence 193c:289d (frames at +0Eh) at the saved position [12ba]/[12bc] (1000:8339), the vehicle drawn before step 3 in state 0Dh and from step 3 in state 2; at the end state 0 (and [2911] = 0) from state 2, state 7 from state 0Dh; [12aa] = 0

name: Car_DrawSplashFrame
description: SI = frame: a 24 x 24 frame from 193c:45e3 + frame * 240h at the saved position [bx+12ba]/[bx+12bc] lifted by the height, plain

name: Car_DrawRipples
description: vehicle bx's ripples: a ring of five 6-byte entries at [bx+135d] (x, y, frame) with cursor [bx+1298]; draws the live ones as 32 x 32 frames (1000:847e), ages them when [12b2] runs out (5 frames); adds one at the vehicle's position when [128c] is set and the timer [12b4] has run out (then [12b4] = 6)

name: Car_DrawOverlay8
description: theme 8: a 32 x 32 frame (four frames cycling with the counter [bx+1392] / 2) over vehicle bx's position (a rotor, inferred from the theme); the final test of the counter has no effect

name: Car_Draw32
description: SI = frame, DI/AX = screen x/y of the centre: a 32 x 32 frame from 193c:5ee3 + frame * 400h, clipped, plain

name: Race_StateStart
description: vehicle state 0Ah (set by the race set-up 1000:3c09): [26ca] = 1; for the player (or both in head-to-head) adds [263a] (steps per frame) to [26d5]; while below 60h the vehicle blinks (not drawn when [26cf] = 1) with effect 9 for the player; then all four vehicles go to state 0, [264e] = [2650] = 32h, [26ca] = 0; the computer vehicles leave state 0Ah when vehicle 0 has

name: Race_StateScored
description: head-to-head, vehicle state 0Bh (the scorer) and from the race frame: silences engines, spins the scorer [26b8] by 8 per frame (not in theme 9) and, while the bar [26b4] is 2..6 and laps remain, shows the 88 x 22 banner 193c:7423 at the screen centre (1000:9289)

name: Race_StateLostPoint
description: head-to-head, vehicle state 0Ch and from the race frame and the race loop's end: silences engines; for the scorer [26b8]: theme 8 spins it; on a winning bar value (sum of [26b4] and [26b6] 1 or 0Fh) or when [26c2] is 0 or C8h slides the banner 193c:7c63 down from the top to y = 7Ch (8 per frame) with effect 10h, hides the other player ([2621]) and records the winner 1/2 in [2630]; otherwise shows the banner 193c:7423

name: Race_DrawBannerOut
description: while [26c2] < 3: slides the banner 193c:7423 left by 8 per frame from [26be]; at [26c2] in 3..63h draws the banner 193c:84a3 at [26be]/[26c0] instead; the code from 864f to 866e is unreachable

name: Dead_BannerReset
description: unreachable tail inside 1000:8634 (after its unconditional jump): would reset the banner position and [26c2] when it left the screen at x = -58h; contains a compare with no branch

name: Race_StateCourseDone
description: vehicle state 0Fh (theme 9: set at 1000:4b13 when vehicle 0 has reached the lap count 2 in [12ed] and stopped, before the time ran out): effect 10h (AH=0Ah test, AH=5), the vehicle drawn and the banner 193c:8ce3 dropped from the top (1000:86d2); [291d] = 1

name: Race_StateTimeUp
description: vehicle state 10h (theme 9's time limit ran out, 1000:7429): effect 0Fh, the banner 193c:9523 dropped from the top (1000:86d2), [291d] = 0, engines silenced

name: Race_DropBanner
description: SI = banner: draws the vehicle, then the banner at x = 80h dropping 8 per frame from the top ([26c0]; [26c2] = 3e8h marks it running) to y = 7Ch, where the race ends ([26c6] = 2)

name: Car_DrawShell
description: vehicle bx's shell ([1394] set; [13a4] the timer, [1398]/[139c] position, [139a]/[139e] the height offset): in flight (timer > 28h) the 8 x 8 shell 193c:72e3 (frame [1396] / 4) and its shadow in colour 0 at the offset point; in the last 0Ah steps the burst 193c:41e3 with the frame from the cs: table at 1000:8780 (0..5..0); counts [13a4] down and ends the shell at 0

name: Car_ShellStepFrac
description: one sub-pixel step: adds the signed byte AL to the fraction in AH's high nibble, carrying (or borrowing) into CX; called six times per axis by the shell's motion 1000:51b2

name: Car_StateFall
description: vehicle state 1 (fell off, sank: set by the terrain handlers): speed [127a] = 0; themes 4 and 9 first turn the vehicle to face 0 or 80h by 4 per frame; then one of the sequences 193c:27c1, 27dd, 27f9 (theme 2: 2835) by [12c2], frames from 1000:7fe8 (theme 9: 1000:8034), effect 7 at step 8 (themes 2, 4, 9: effect 11h at step 4); at the end state 7 (respawn). Also a terrain handler (theme 8, 9 tables)

name: Dead_HudDrawNumber
description: unreachable: draws AX as four digits right to left (DI moving 8 left per digit, 1000:905f), a minus glyph (digit 0Ah) first if negative

name: Track_ScrollBackdrop
description: themes 1, 3 and 5, each presented frame: rewrites tile 0 of the tile graphics (segment 1b78, 16 x 16) from the 16 x 16 pattern at 193c:3ee3, shifted by half the camera position ([264a], [264c] mod 32 / 2) so that the backdrop scrolls at half speed

name: Track_AnimateWater2
description: theme 2, each presented frame: counter [26d1]; every four frames writes the next of four tile sets (00h, 10h, 20h, 30h based) into a 4 x 4 block of map entries at 4478:8046 (rows 180h bytes apart)

name: Track_AnimateTiles8
description: theme 8 unless track [28c0] = 1: counter [26d3] cycles three frames (tile bases 0, 9, 12h, four steps each); writes 3 x 3 blocks of map entries in the map at 3b78 (track 3: several blocks at 3b78 and 4478; other tracks one block)

name: Dead_SetOverscan
description: unreachable: sets the VGA overscan (border) colour to AH through attribute register 11h (resets the flip-flop at 3dah, re-enables the display with 20h)

name: Gfx_ClipSprite
description: DI = x, AX = y (screen, 0..ffh x 0..dfh window), CX = width, DX = height, SI = source: clips the rectangle to the window; carry set if nothing is left; else DI = back-buffer offset (row * 110h + 1110h - cs:[8994]), SI advanced past clipped pixels, CL = visible width, CH = visible rows, DX = source bytes to skip per row. Quirk: a sprite cut at the bottom gets the offset of row 200 (C8h) whatever its y (1000:8c1b)

name: Gfx_BlitSilhouette
description: after 1000:8bab: draws the sprite's non-zero pixels in colour 0 into the back buffer (ES = 6d78, stride 110h); shadows and the blink

name: Gfx_BlitRecolour

name: Hud_DrawPositions
description: each presented frame: theme 9 shows the time left [26c8] / 16 as digits at the top; head-to-head ranks the two players (leader by laps left [12ed] and progress [12e3], against the gap [2654] when both are out of laps) and draws the eight-step point bar from [26b4] (icons 193c:5ae3 / 59e3); otherwise ranks the four vehicles by (9 - laps left) * [2652] + progress (bubble sort of 193c:2670 scores and 2678 order), writes each vehicle's position [12ef] = 1..4, and draws the leader's lap count and a column of position digits with each vehicle's icon in its colour

name: Hud_DrawCarIcon

name: Hud_DrawDigit

name: Hud_DrawCarPosition

name: Race_DrawFrame
description: the race picture, only on the last game step of a presented frame ([2638] = 1): ES = back buffer 6d78 (rows of 110h); per-theme tile animation (1000:8996, 89e0, 8a2b); then 17 x 14 tiles of the map (words at 3b78.., 192 x 192 tiles wrapping, rows 180h bytes) from the camera [264a]/[264c], each 16 x 16 tile copied from the tile graphics at 1b78 + tile * 10h; tiles with bit 15 set have their buffer offset and segment pushed on the stack (SP saved in cs:[90c3]); cs:[8994] = the low two bits of the scroll; then the head-to-head point and respawn logic (1000:78f8 / 7759), the vehicles (1000:7ce0), the pushed tiles redrawn from the stack as transparent foreground (offset C00h in their graphics) until SP is back at cs:[90c3], the HUD (1000:8dfc), the head-to-head banners (1000:851f, 855a, 8634) and the engine sounds (1000:7b46). No present and no wait here

name: Gfx_DrawBanner

name: Gfx_PresentScrolled

name: Menu_RedefineKeys
description: the REDEFINE KEYS screen: prompts for five keys per player (two prompts, 193c:ae3d / ae44), reads each press from the keyboard handler's [107e] (Esc aborts, space ignored, a key already taken refused), shows each key's name from the table 193c:adf0 (scan code, character pairs; '?' if not listed) and stores the ten codes into the key table 193c:106c (five for player 1, five at 1074); its first call (to 1000:0400) has a displacement that wraps around the end of the segment

name: Overlay_Entry
description: the overlay segment's far entry, two programs in turn: first FONT.BIN, the code-card check (called once by 1000:31f0 with AX = 0; AX = 0 back = passed), then DRIVERn.BIN, the sound driver (loaded by 1000:321c), with the function in AH (meanings from the callers, to be confirmed when the driver is read): 0 initialise (DX = 388h, BX/CX from 193c:000b/000d), 2 (CX = 4287h, repeated until AL = 0), 3 the per-frame tick (from the timer handler once cs:3279 is set), 9 is tune AL there (AL = 0: no) then 4 play tune AL, 5 sound effect AL, 0Ah query effect AL, 0Eh engine tone (AL channel, CX), 6, 7 and 8 stop (music, all), 10h off (AL = 0)
